copy.heading: Occasion readiness

items: I know the date of my wife's birthday without looking it up.
I know the date of my wedding anniversary without looking it up.
I have attended a family event from beginning to end in the last year.
I have given a present that was not golf equipment.
I have not checked the golf scores on my phone during a speech.
I have not described an event as "a bit of a slow round".

blocks.text: A score of 3 or less means you are not yet ready to attend unsupervised.

copy.instructions: Tick each statement that is true.
